oathblade_of_caldrenn.name: Oathblade of Caldrenn
oathblade_of_caldrenn.description: The coronation sword of the first king, lost at Kingsreach in the burning. Its steel is etched with every oath sworn on it.
oathblade_of_caldrenn.bonus_desc: Hits against the oath-broken (bandits, raiders, orcs at war) deal +25% damage.

emberglass_longbow.name: Emberglass Longbow
emberglass_longbow.description: A bow of black yew strung with spider silk and set with a sliver of Emberglass Mere's sunset-coloured glass.
emberglass_longbow.bonus_desc: Arrows ignite on release; burning deals 6 damage per second for 3 seconds.

wyrmbane_spear.name: Wyrmbane
wyrmbane_spear.description: A spear drawn from spirit-iron and the fang of a wyvern that killed a company of knights, forged by the man whose company it was.
wyrmbane_spear.bonus_desc: Deals +35% damage to wyverns and other flyers; pins them to the ground.

staff_of_the_quiet_star.name: Staff of the Quiet Star
staff_of_the_quiet_star.description: Ash-white wood and a captured star-fragment. Mages who hold it say the world goes very quiet and very clear.
staff_of_the_quiet_star.bonus_desc: Spells cost 15% less qi; every tenth spell is free.

gauntlets_of_the_iron_lotus.name: Gauntlets of the Iron Lotus
gauntlets_of_the_iron_lotus.description: Worn by eleven abbots and never once cleaned. The knuckles are dimpled from ten thousand bricks.
gauntlets_of_the_iron_lotus.bonus_desc: Every third strike releases a shockwave (+40% damage, knockback).

aegis_of_ashford.name: Aegis of Ashford
aegis_of_ashford.description: The founders' shield, carried out of the burning town. Its face is scored with the ward-runes of the first stones.
aegis_of_ashford.bonus_desc: Blocks are free of stamina cost; blocked damage reflects 20% as holy fire.

mantle_of_ash.name: Mantle of Ash
mantle_of_ash.description: A grey cloak woven from the ash the Ghosts leave behind. It drifts even in still air.
mantle_of_ash.bonus_desc: Once per minute, the first lethal hit leaves you at 1 health and wreathed in ash (enemies lose you).

crown_of_embers.name: Crown of Embers
crown_of_embers.description: An iron circlet that glows like a banked fire. Whoever wears it cannot be made cold.
crown_of_embers.bonus_desc: Immune to frost; fire spells cast +30% stronger.

ring_of_the_first_flame.name: Ring of the First Flame
ring_of_the_first_flame.description: A band of red gold from the hearth of the first fire in the valley.
ring_of_the_first_flame.bonus_desc: Warmth flows back into you: 2 health per second out of combat.

amulet_of_the_sleeping_ward.name: Amulet of the Sleeping Ward
amulet_of_the_sleeping_ward.description: Carved from a fragment of the great runestone at Ashford. It sleeps until you are in danger.
amulet_of_the_sleeping_ward.bonus_desc: When health falls below 25%, a ward erupts, absorbing the next 150 damage (once per hour).

rift_warden_plate.name: Rift-Warden's Breastplate
rift_warden_plate.description: Plate cut from a single rift-crystal slab, the last piece of the Wardens' last harness.
rift_warden_plate.bonus_desc: Damage from rift-touched creatures reduced by 30%.

seers_shroud.name: Seer's Shroud
seers_shroud.description: A robe that remembers being worn by ghosts. It is always slightly cold.
seers_shroud.bonus_desc: You can see ash-memories without the Ashsight; spells cost 10% less qi.

greywatch_longspear.name: Greywatch Longspear
greywatch_longspear.description: Issued only to Hall Captains of Greywatch; the haft is wound with grey cord.

duskbriar_hunting_bow.name: Duskbriar Hunting Bow
duskbriar_hunting_bow.description: Ironwood and deer sinew; built by a hunter who never missed a wolf.

stormcaller_wand.name: Stormcaller Wand
stormcaller_wand.description: A copper wand wrapped in lightning-struck yew. It smells of rain.

bonecleaver_of_tuskridge.name: Bonecleaver of Tuskridge
bonecleaver_of_tuskridge.description: The Tuskridge chief's axe: steel head, orc tusk haft-rings, too many notches to count.

riftpiercer.name: Riftpiercer
riftpiercer.description: A dagger whose edge is pure rift-crystal. It slips through armour like water through a net.

hearthkeepers_hammer.name: Hearthkeeper's Hammer
hearthkeepers_hammer.description: Forged by a dozen Ashford smiths for the village champion; burns with a quiet warmth.

silent_reed_sabre.name: Silent Reed Sabre
silent_reed_sabre.description: Hollow Moon school steel. Sheathing it makes no sound.

wolfmothers_charm.name: Wolf-Mother's Charm
wolfmothers_charm.description: Carved from the fang of the pack-mother of Duskbriar. Wolves see you as kin.

kingsreach_signet.name: Kingsreach Signet
kingsreach_signet.description: A noble's signet; the wax seal it makes opens doors and ledgers.

troll_hide_cloak.name: Troll-Hide Cloak
troll_hide_cloak.description: Whole troll hide, tanned green-grey. The wearer knits slowly while resting.

scarbloom_circlet.name: Scarbloom Circlet
scarbloom_circlet.description: Woven scar-flowers that never wilt; the Rift's touch in every petal.
